title: Cursed Fate: Tooth Manipulation
description: my first cursed fate addon mod, adds tooth Manipulation
body:
Adds tooth Manipulation Technique

Teeth Cannon
Chant: Launch yourself back, good for movement.
Flow: Increases the amount of projectiles and the speed of the projectiles.
Teething: uses a stronger projectile.

Teeth Burst
Biting Armor: changes the angle of the attack.
Chant: Summons teeth chunks in the ground.
Flow: Increases the amount of projectiles and the speed of the projectiles.
Teething: uses a stronger projectile.

Biting Armor
Chant: Deals more damage.
Flow: Lasts Longer.
Teething: Summons Teeth chunks in the ground.

Teething
Allows the user to use their Technique to the fullest

Roundsaw Jaw
Flow: Increases the duration of the attack and Bleeding lasts longer and deals more damage.
Teething: Increases the size of the attack.

Teethstorm
Flow: Increases the duration of the attack.
Teething: Increases the size of the attack.


1 New enemy
toothling 

2 New enchantments
soul hit (ingores 30% of armor)
lightning (summons lightning on hit)

1 New weapon
tooth blade


this mod is based off joel from look outside(W Game)
